note: Paragraphs Entity Embed adds inline Paragraph embedding to CKEditor 5. Enabling on a text format = the 'Display embedded paragraphs' filter (id paragraphs_entity_embed, TYPE_TRANSFORM_REVERSIBLE) + the Paragraphs CKEditor 5 button (plugin paragraphs_entity_embed_paragraphsEmbed / DrupalParagraph). Each embed is stored as an embedded_paragraphs content entity (base fields label + paragraph=entity_reference_revisions to a paragraph; tables embedded_paragraphs/_revision) and referenced in markup by a <drupal-paragraph> tag with data attributes (data-embed-button, data-paragraph-id, data-paragraph-revision-id, data-entity-label, data-align). Ships embed.button 'paragraphs' (embed type paragraphs_entity_embed) and view mode paragraph.embed. Five permissions: view/add/edit/delete/administer paragraphs entity embed. No global settings page (configure=null). Deps: ckeditor5, embed, entity_embed, paragraphs. Medium reads back which text format has the filter enabled; hard1 enables the filter on a text format (verified via live filter config); hard2 creates an embedded_paragraphs entity referencing a paragraph (verified as live entity). NOTE: hard2 uses the existing bp_simple paragraph type - creating/deleting a paragraphs_type triggers an admin_toolbar menu-rebuild collision on this shared site, so scripts avoid paragraphs_type CRUD.

evals.prompt: How do I let editors embed Paragraph entities inside a CKEditor 5 rich-text field using the Paragraphs Entity Embed module? What two things must I enable on the text format?
evals.expected_output: On the text format (admin/config/content/formats), enable the 'Display embedded paragraphs' filter (id paragraphs_entity_embed) and add the Paragraphs button (CKEditor 5 plugin paragraphs_entity_embed_paragraphsEmbed) to the active toolbar.

evals.prompt: In the Paragraphs Entity Embed module, what entity type stores an embedded paragraph, and what are its main fields? What HTML tag references it in the saved markup?
evals.expected_output: Embeds are stored as embedded_paragraphs content entities (base fields: label, and paragraph = entity_reference_revisions to a paragraph). In the text they are referenced by a <drupal-paragraph> tag carrying data attributes like data-paragraph-id, data-paragraph-revision-id, data-entity-label and data-align.

evals.prompt: Which permissions does the Paragraphs Entity Embed module define to control who can work with embedded paragraphs?
evals.expected_output: It defines view / add / edit / delete paragraphs entity embed (the CRUD operations on embedded_paragraphs entities) and administer paragraphs entity embed (restricted).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, one text format has been configured to allow embedding Paragraph entities in CKEditor via the Paragraphs Entity Embed module. Inspect the live text-format configuration and give the machine name of the format that has the embed filter enabled.
evals.expected_output: The pee_format text format has the paragraphs_entity_embed ('Display embedded paragraphs') filter enabled (status true).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an existing embedded paragraph (an embedded_paragraphs entity created by the Paragraphs Entity Embed module). Inspect the live embedded_paragraphs entities and give the label of the one that exists.
evals.expected_output: There is an embedded_paragraphs entity with label 'PEE Known Embed' (wrapping a bp_simple paragraph).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format 'pee_exec' that does not yet allow embedded paragraphs. Using the Paragraphs Entity Embed module, enable paragraph embedding output on that format by turning on its filter, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the paragraphs_entity_embed filter on the pee_exec format (e.g. $format->setFilterConfig('paragraphs_entity_embed', ['status' => TRUE])->save()). Verify passes when that filter's status is TRUE on pee_exec.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, using the Paragraphs Entity Embed module, create a reusable embedded paragraph: an embedded_paragraphs entity labelled 'PEE Hard Embed' that wraps a new paragraph of the existing 'bp_simple' type. Save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create and save a Paragraph of type bp_simple, then create an EmbeddedParagraphs entity with label 'PEE Hard Embed' whose paragraph field references it. Verify passes when an embedded_paragraphs entity labelled 'PEE Hard Embed' exists and references at least one paragraph.
